claimArguments.boundedProposition: For admitted histories and the accepted compatibility update, every non-empty update is a subset of the preceding hypothesis set and contains each hypothesis compatible with the accumulated history.
assumptions: the initial set covers the registered hypothesis domain
observation compatibility is evaluated using the accepted interval rule
falsifiers: an accepted update adds a hypothesis absent from the preceding set
a compatible truth hypothesis is removed by the accepted update
claimArguments.allowedWording: bounded history-monotonicity and compatibility retention under the registered model and admitted observations
claimArguments.forbiddenWording: universal convergence, completeness, or certification of arbitrary systems

claimArguments.boundedProposition: Under the registered arm contracts, CL-LOOP may condition a later admissible action on its own earlier observations while CL-T, CL-A, and CL-TA may not; any empirical gain remains pending execution.
assumptions: all arms receive the same registered initial information
cost is charged on issued actions
falsifiers: a comparator receives later CL-LOOP observations
a reported gain disappears under the registered parent metric
claimArguments.allowedWording: a testable feedback distinction and candidate closed-loop protocol
claimArguments.forbiddenWording: proven empirical superiority or optimality before confirmatory execution

costAccounting.doubleChargeRule: recovery is a preparation detail and is never added twice to the projected preparation component

scenarios.perturbationPoint: no perturbation; qualified upload completion control
scenarios.truthConfirmation: controlled scene definition plus terminal-status evidence
scenarios.observableOutcome: qualified completion evidence; normal singleton does not by itself establish protocol PASS
scenarios.resetEvidence: fresh session and IUT reset identifier
scenarios.admissionRule: admit only after scene identity, reset, and observation qualification pass

scenarios.perturbationPoint: WAIT/continuation event timing and state transition
scenarios.truthConfirmation: confirmed event script and evaluator timing record
scenarios.observableOutcome: WAIT preserves the active obligation until continuation
scenarios.admissionRule: admit only when event ownership and both measurement intervals are reconstructable

scenarios.perturbationPoint: owned response suppression after a confirmed request
scenarios.truthConfirmation: confirmed suppression plus complete qualified observation horizon
scenarios.observableOutcome: FAIL only when the valid uncancelled obligation expires; insufficient evidence remains non-FAIL
scenarios.admissionRule: admit only confirmed, non-equivalent suppression with a complete qualified horizon

scenarios.perturbationPoint: owned abort event during active transfer
scenarios.observableOutcome: abort cancels only the owned obligation and does not waive unrelated clocks
scenarios.admissionRule: admit only when the abort is causally linked to one request instance

scenarios.perturbationPoint: capture timestamp, coverage, or ownership evidence
scenarios.truthConfirmation: evaluator construction record, not an IUT-fault label
scenarios.observableOutcome: ERROR or existing qualification result; never direct IUT blame
scenarios.admissionRule: retain in all-attempt accounting but exclude from IUT PASS/FAIL denominators

scenarios.perturbationPoint: concurrent requests sharing a correlation key
scenarios.observableOutcome: one owner or explicit ambiguity; no response reuse
scenarios.admissionRule: admit only when ambiguity is represented rather than silently resolved

scenarios.observableOutcome: paired comparison only after independent full reset
scenarios.admissionRule: admit paired units only when configuration differs solely at the registered perturbation

scenarios.perturbationPoint: declared resource controller or tool-error path
scenarios.observableOutcome: named ERROR/budget exit with all spent cost retained; not IUT nonconformance
scenarios.admissionRule: retain every registered attempt and distinguish budget exhaustion from tool error

acceptanceMatrixDispositions.rationale: fixes artifact and IUT identity before a run
separates tool/capture anomalies from IUT findings
format preconditions belong to the selected environment
network identity is frozen with the IUT configuration
transport setup is verified before scenario admission
field evidence is collected by protocol scenarios
ownership is a per-attempt causal fact
history state is reconstructed per run
state transitions support outcome and stop attribution
budget and charge modes are frozen before execution
experiment identity and pairing are control-plane gates
authority drift invalidates the registered design

populations.predicate: one row per unique registered attemptId
populations.retentionRule: retain every registered attempt, including excluded, unresolved, abstaining, incomplete, and error attempts

populations.predicate: validity == VALID and outcome in {PASS, FAIL}
populations.retentionRule: ERROR, INCONCLUSIVE, and NOT-ANSWERED are not answered

populations.predicate: injectionStatus == NORMAL and faultDomain == NORMAL and validity == VALID
populations.retentionRule: invalid normal controls stay in POP-ATTEMPTS only

populations.predicate: injectionStatus == CONFIRMED and faultDomain == IN-DOMAIN-NON-EQUIVALENT and runId != null
populations.retentionRule: confirmed equivalents and unresolved injections stay visible but are not scored as faults

populations.predicate: member of POP-CONFIRMED-FAULT and outcome == PASS
populations.retentionRule: non-answered fault attempts remain in the fault denominator but not the answered denominator

populations.predicate: member of POP-QUALIFIED-NORMAL and outcome == FAIL
populations.retentionRule: tool ERROR is not a false fail

populations.predicate: member of POP-ANSWERED and either POP-MISSES or POP-FALSE-FAILS

populations.retentionRule: a singleton survivor does not override an abstention stop
retain interval-overlap cases without forcing PASS or FAIL
retain cause and spent cost without IUT blame
retain partial history and charged cost
eligibility does not require a decision

populations.predicate: member of POP-LOCALIZATION-ELIGIBLE and localizationDecisionIssued == true
populations.retentionRule: empty/error exits remain only in the eligible population

populations.predicate: member of POP-LOCALIZATION-DECISION and truth hypothesis occurs in finalHypotheses
populations.retentionRule: evaluate using evaluator-only truth after the run

populations.predicate: member of POP-LOCALIZATION-DECISION and truth hypothesis is absent from finalHypotheses
populations.retentionRule: report separately from absence of a localization decision

populations.predicate: member of POP-LOCALIZATION-DECISION and singletonDecisionIssued == true and len(finalHypotheses) == 1
populations.retentionRule: stop class alone cannot manufacture a singleton decision

populations.predicate: member of POP-SINGLETON-DECISION and sole hypothesis equals truth
populations.retentionRule: wrong singleton remains in singleton denominator

populations.predicate: two registered rows share a non-null pairingId and satisfy their parent metric population
populations.retentionRule: unmatched rows remain visible and are not imputed

metrics.direction: higher with errors and abstentions jointly reported

metrics.censoringRule: no censoring; budget and error exits remain in denominator

metrics.missingRule: missing evaluator truth invalidates error classification

metrics.calculation: valid PASS / confirmed in-domain non-equivalent fault attempts
metrics.missingRule: unconfirmed or unresolved injection is retained outside this denominator
metrics.censoringRule: budget/error exits remain in fault denominator and are reported separately

metrics.missingRule: unqualified normal controls stay outside this denominator
metrics.censoringRule: tool errors are not false failures

metrics.missingRule: missing outcome or validity invalidates row

metrics.calculation: incomplete or budget-exhausted attempts / all attempts
issued localization decisions / eligible localization attempts
metrics.censoringRule: empty/error stops remain in eligible denominator

metrics.calculation: decisions retaining truth / issued localization decisions
metrics.missingRule: missing truth or final set invalidates row
metrics.censoringRule: no-decision attempts are reported by coverage, not silently removed

metrics.calculation: decisions excluding truth / issued localization decisions
metrics.missingRule: missing truth or final set invalidates row

metrics.direction: lower subject to truth retention and coverage
metrics.censoringRule: include incomplete and empty exits with stop class

metrics.calculation: project detail costs to (acquisition, computation, preparation, retry), folding recovery into preparation once
metrics.direction: lower only with success and coverage jointly reported
metrics.censoringRule: include spent cost for incomplete and error exits

metrics.direction: lower only with outcome jointly reported
metrics.censoringRule: right-censor at the registered round limit

metrics.calculation: within-pair arm difference for each named parent metric
metrics.missingRule: unmatched pairs are reported and not imputed
metrics.censoringRule: inherits each parent metric censoring rule

analysisPlans.estimand: distribution of survivor count, cost, or rounds
analysisPlans.pairing: paired summaries when the scenario contract supplies pairingId

analysisPlans.effectMeasure: Vargha-Delaney A12 or paired difference when applicable

analysisPlans.applicability: only when parent metric semantics and pair completeness both hold
